screening_decisions.reason: Prospective randomized clinical study comparing biocompatible polyacrylonitrile (BCM) vs bioincompatible cuprophane (BICM) membranes in 72 patients with ARF requiring hemodialysis. Meets all criteria.
Observational study describing experiences in Vietnam combat casualties. Not a randomized trial and does not compare BCM vs BICM membranes.
Prospective observational study assessing prognostic factors. While it mentions membrane type associations, this was not a randomized comparison of BCM vs BICM.
Prospective randomized study comparing cuprophane (BICM) vs polyacrylonitrile (BCM) membranes in 52 patients with ARF requiring hemodialysis. Meets all criteria.
Randomized trial but compares two synthetic membranes (both biocompatible) with different pore sizes. Does not compare BCM vs BICM. Also uses hemofiltration, not intermittent hemodialysis.
Meta-analysis about myocardial infarction treatments. Wrong population and intervention entirely.
Compares two synthetic membranes (polyamide vs polyacrylonitrile), both biocompatible. Does not compare BCM vs BICM. Also uses hemofiltration, not intermittent hemodialysis.

Randomized trial comparing cellulose acetate (substituted cellulose, less biocompatible) vs polysulfone (synthetic BCM) in 66 patients with ARF requiring intermittent hemodialysis. Meets all criteria.
Meta-analysis of previously published trials, not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Methodological paper about meta-analysis statistics. Not a clinical trial.
Abstract does not describe randomization method. Appears to be observational or non-randomized comparison. Insufficient evidence of RCT design.
Observational study analyzing prognostic factors. Not a randomized trial and does not compare membrane types.
Randomized trial but compares two synthetic membranes (PAN vs polysulfone), both biocompatible. Does not compare BCM vs BICM. Also uses continuous venovenous dialysis, not intermittent hemodialysis.
Review article summarizing clinical trials. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Commentary/discussion about meta-analyses. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Abstract contains only bibliographic references, no actual study content. Cannot assess eligibility.
Study about publication bias in oncology trials. Wrong population and topic entirely.
Review article about dialysate purity. Not a randomized trial comparing membranes.
Study about pre-transplantation dialysis strategies in kidney transplant recipients. Wrong population (not ARF patients).
Observational registry study analyzing risk factors. Not a randomized trial and does not compare membrane types.
Review article discussing dialysis-related variables. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.

Crossover study with alternate assignment (quasi-randomized) comparing cellulose acetate (substituted cellulose) vs polysulfone (BCM) in 24 patients with ARF requiring intermittent hemodialysis. Meets criteria.
Prospective randomized study comparing cellulose diacetate (modified cellulose, less biocompatible) vs polysulfone (BCM) in 159 patients with ARF requiring hemodialysis. Meets all criteria.
Review article discussing membrane biocompatibility concepts. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Randomized trial but compares two synthetic membranes (both biocompatible) with different flux characteristics. Does not compare BCM vs BICM.
Observational study using USRDS registry data. Not a randomized trial. Also focuses on chronic dialysis patients, not ARF.
Prospective randomized multicentre trial comparing Cuprophan (BICM) vs polymethyl-methacrylate (BCM) in 180 patients with ARF requiring hemodialysis. Meets all criteria.
Meta-analysis about ACE inhibitors in nondiabetic renal disease. Wrong intervention and population.
Review article about renal replacement therapies. Not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Randomized trial comparing dialysis modalities (EDD vs CHD), not membrane types. Does not compare BCM vs BICM.
Prospective multicenter study with alternating order assignment (quasi-randomized) comparing BCM vs BICM membranes in 153 patients with ARF requiring dialysis. Meets all criteria.
Post-hoc analysis of observational data from French Prospective Multicenter Study. Membrane type was not defined by protocol (centers followed usual practice). Not randomized.
Randomized trial but compares two synthetic membranes (both biocompatible) with different pore sizes. Does not compare BCM vs BICM. Also uses continuous hemofiltration, not intermittent hemodialysis.
Expert discussion forum/debate article. Not a clinical trial.
